exclusions: Every lead and candidate in prior immutable requests through 2026-08-18 was excluded, together with all 26 canonical identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, protected Deep Under to Wurk opening handoff, Iruka summit, protected ending, and untriggered PARKED entries.

The Third Room Curation One tracks were strong belonging evidence but excluded before resolution because no reliable exact-track tempo source was found; artist stature, release recency, and constitution-like copy were not allowed to substitute for a lawful neighbour test.

Ashley Nield, Hannah Addams, aM.IT, WHM, Inspired Groove, and Dino Lenny material was excluded where available descriptions foregrounded peak-time drive, raw intensity, pressure, pummelling kicks, vocals, explicit impact, or release-level qualities that could not establish exact-track restraint.

Cossmann and other dub-oriented material was excluded where exact BPM remained unsupported or the evidence stayed release-level rather than distinguishing an individual track and a non-frozen placement.

Tenzia Soft Push was excluded at 150 BPM; Mordio C7RT was excluded because relentless drive and 140 BPM duplicated occupied pressure functions; Vanta Subkutan was excluded at 77 BPM. Mitra Hush alone retained exact-track role language and a lawful early path.

Overlooked Feral material at 126 BPM would require altering the protected ending, while Dycide and Polygonia Elasticity at 95 BPM and the remaining Hypnus, IO, and Systolic material lacked either exact-track role evidence or a lawful non-protected placement.
No lead was admitted for novelty, release recency, popularity, duration, BPM, key, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.
explorationReceipt.evidenceLimit: Official release-level description explicitly naming Hush plus exact retailer identity, duration, tempo, and ISRC metadata only; no Spotify audio analysis, no raw-audio measurement, and no candidate-specific listener report.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

proposedPlacements.role: warm bass-led colour shift after the protected opening handoff

requestedIdentity.fitHypothesis: IO's release note explicitly describes Hush as opening with bass-heavy, bubbly textures and a warm, energetic tone; at 137 BPM it can be tested only after the protected Deep Under to Wurk handoff as a possible early colour shift, but whether that warmth and bass movement create a distinct perspective rather than duplicate Deprogramation 2's arrival groove-lock shelf remains unknown.
